messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide you can follow to get your acoustic guitar sold quickly—and hopefully at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Helps | |------|------------|--------------| | **1️⃣ Inspect & Clean** | Give it a thorough wipe down, check strings, bridge pins, nut slots, and look for cracks or warps. Replace worn parts if possible. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more valuable and reduces buyer hesitation. | | **2️⃣ Take High‑Quality Photos** | • Front view
• Back view
• Close‑up of headstock, fretboard, soundhole, hardware
• Any scratches/marks
• If you’re selling used gear, show the serial number | Great pics attract clicks—especially on mobile devices where buyers often browse first glance. | | **3️⃣ Write a Clear Description** | • Brand/model, year, wood types, finish
• Condition notes (“excellent”, “minor wear”)
• Included accessories (case, strap, picks)
• Reason for sale (upgrade, moved) | Transparency builds trust and cuts back on repetitive questions. | | **4️⃣ Research Pricing** | Search recent sales on eBay, Reverb, Gearslutz, Facebook groups, and local listings. Use the *“sold”* filter when available. | You’ll set a realistic asking price that attracts offers but still leaves room for negotiation. | --- ### Where to List Your Guitar | Platform | Best For | Tips | |----------|-----------|-------| | **Reverb.com** | Musicians looking for quality gear | Free basic listing; paid upgrades boost visibility. | | **eBay** | Broad audience + auction option | Consider starting with a fixed price plus “Best Offer.” | | **Craigslist / Kijiji** | Local buyers who prefer pickup | Post clear contact details; meet in safe public places. | | **Facebook Marketplace / Groups** | Quick local sales | Join dedicated guitar or musical instrument groups. | | **OfferUp / Letgo** | Mobile-friendly local marketplace | Upload multiple angles; use keywords like “Acoustic,” “Guitar.” | | **Local Music Stores** | Trade‑in or consignment | Ask about their buyback program; they may offer instant cash or store credit. | | **Consignment Shops** | Higher-end models | Good for vintage or high‑value guitars; shop handles marketing and payment. | --- ### Setting Up Shipping (if selling online) 1. **Choose Packaging:** - Hard case → sturdy cardboard box + foam inserts. - Soft case → padded envelope or bubble mailer (rarely recommended). 2. **Insurance & Tracking:** - Insure for full value (most carriers do this automatically for expensive items). - Always include tracking so both parties know delivery status. 3. **Shipping Costs:** - Get quotes from USPS, UPS, FedEx. - Many sellers cover part of the cost; consider adding a small surcharge to keep profit margin intact. --- ### Safety When Meeting Buyers In Person - Meet during daylight hours in a busy area (coffee shop parking lot, grocery store entrance). - Bring a friend or family member if possible. - Verify ID before handing over keys/case. - Accept only secure payments (cash, Venmo, PayPal Goods & Services). --- ### Sample Listing Template ``` Title: Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition – $350 OBO Description: – Model: Yamaha FG800 (2009) – Wood: Spruce top, rosewood fingerboard – Finish: Natural gloss – Condition: Very lightly played, no visible dents or cracks. Strings replaced last month. – Accessories: Original hard case, extra pick, capo. – Reason for Sale: Moving out of state. Price: $350 or best offer accepted. Must pick up locally within [City] unless buyer pays for insured shipping ($45 flat rate via USPS Priority Mail). Photos attached. Feel free to ask any questions! ``` Feel free to tweak the wording to match your own style and specifics. Once posted, monitor messages promptly—buyers appreciate quick responses! --- #### Final Checklist Before Posting - ✅ All photos uploaded correctly - ✅ Accurate title & keyword usage - ✅ Price researched & listed - ✅ Contact information verified - ✅ Payment method(s) confirmed Good luck! With solid prep and a bit of patience, you’ll find a new home for your guitar soon. 🎸
message.reasoning:
The user asks "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We need to provide guidance: listing online marketplaces (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace), local classifieds, music stores trade-in programs, consignment shops, etc. Also mention condition assessment, pricing research, photos, description, shipping options, safety tips.

We don't have to call the tool because it's about tuning an instrument; not relevant here. So just respond with helpful info. No code needed.
